import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages')
import uno, os, time
from com.sun.star.beans import PropertyValue

def connect(tries=30):
    localContext = uno.getComponentContext()
    resolver = localContext.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext(
        "com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver", localContext)
    for i in range(tries):
        try:
            ctx = resolver.resolve("uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext")
            return ctx
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(1)
    raise SystemExit("no connect")

ctx = connect()
smgr = ctx.ServiceManager
desktop = smgr.createInstanceWithContext("com.sun.star.frame.Desktop", ctx)
url = uno.systemPathToFileUrl(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]))
props = [PropertyValue(Name="Hidden", Value=True)]
doc = desktop.loadComponentFromURL(url, "_blank", 0, tuple(props))
# recalc hard
doc.calculateAll()
outurl = uno.systemPathToFileUrl(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[2]))
doc.storeToURL(outurl, (PropertyValue(Name="FilterName", Value="Calc MS Excel 2007 XML"),))
doc.close(False)
print("done")
EOF
